title: campanula cochleariifolia subsp. reflexa
intro: Campanula cochleariifolia subsp. reflexa, commonly known as the reflex bellflower, is a plant species belonging to the Campanula genus. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of various ailments. The therapeutic actions of reflex bellflower are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been shown to possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
